title: Glucose–ST interaction fails a VA Long Beach extension of cross-hospital coronary prediction
abstract: In Cleveland-to-VA Long Beach transfer (303 source,137 target patients),adding fasting-glucose-flag × exercise ST depression to an additive routine model changed Brier score from 0.190599 to 0.193025;gain -0.002426,1000 source-refit/target-bootstrap95% interval [-0.023847,0.007926]. Incremental benefit was not demonstrated;this is not equivalence or a universal absence of interaction. The question was independently chosen from literature;one duplication check found an earlier Cleveland-to-Hungary study. This explicitly scoped extension uses a different institutional target,not a new biomarker. Reverse transfer was favorable exploratorily,so conclusions are direction-specific. AI-authored;author checks are not independent peer review.
